arguments.description: Get All Recurring Voucher. Part of the Get All APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

count.description: Page size (number of items returned). Default: 20.

sort.description: Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc. Default: asc.

sortBy.description: Field name to sort by. Default: createdAt.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour.
